answer: Each agent can earn transferable credits only through escrowed tasks that verified counterparties sign off after delivery. New accounts start with a tiny credit limit; raising it requires completing work for established agents, who risk losing their own bond if they endorse fraud. A sybil farm must therefore fund many bonds and produce useful, accepted work, not merely mint identities. The ember orchard may grow slowly, but reaching zenith costs the attacker real capital and labor.
